title: Media Buyer / Performance Marketer - Meta & Google Ads - (m/w/d)
description: 150.000 € Werbebudget pro Woche in der Peakzeit. Und der Plan ist, dass es mehr wird. Valkental entwickelt seit 2020 Outdoorprodukte für mehr Sicherheit und Komfort im Straßenverkehr. Über 400.000 Kunden vertrauen bereits auf uns. Unser Shop ist achtstellig. Bis 2030 wollen wir neunstellig sein. Genau dafür suchen wir dich. Unsere Meta- und Google-Accounts steuert bisher Antonio, einer der Gründer und Geschäftsführer. Jetzt übergibt er sie. Und zwar an dich. Du übernimmst rund 500.000 € Ad-Spend im Monat, in Vollzeit (40 Stunden pro Woche), 100 % remote und mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung. Nicht, um den Account zu verwalten. Sondern um ihn profitabel zu skalieren. Aufgaben Kurzfassung: Du siehst jeden Tag als Erstes, was im Account passiert, und entscheidest, was als Nächstes kommt. Für den Account. Für die Creatives. Für das Wachstum. Du steuerst Meta und Google täglich: Budgets, Struktur (ABO/CBO), Gebotsstrategien, Kill oder Promote. Du skalierst profitabel. Mehr Spend bei gleichem NC-ROAS ist dein Tagesgeschäft, nicht die Ausnahme. Du fährst Sales-Events wie die Black Week mit sechsstelligem Budget: stündlich checken, intraday skalieren, nachts zurücksetzen. Du liest Triple Whale, Meta, Google, Shopify und unsere Post-Purchase-Survey parallel und weißt, welches Creative gerade trägt und welches Geld verbrennt. Deine Learnings gehen direkt an unsere Creative Strategists. Du testest systematisch: Creatives, Landingpages, Winner erkennen, skalieren, iterieren. Du baust unser wöchentliches KPI-Reporting: Blended ROAS und Shop-Profitabilität über alle Kanäle. Du betreibst unsere Automationen und baust sie mit KI-Routinen weiter aus. Du erschließt neue Kanäle (TikTok, Native, X) und baust sie auf, wenn sie funktionieren. Qualifikation Wir suchen keinen Verwalter. Wir suchen jemanden, der einen großen Account kennt und Bock hat, ihn größer zu machen: Mindestens 2 Jahre Media Buying bei einer E-Commerce-Brand oder Performance-Agentur, mit eigener Budgetverantwortung. Meta ist dein Heimspiel: Auktion, Attribution, Cost Cap vs. Bid Cap, Neukunden-Ausschluss, Frequenz. Du kennst Budgets, bei denen ein Fehler weh tut: mindestens fünfstellig im Monat, mindestens ein sechsstelliges Sales-Event. Google Ads (Search, Shopping, PMax) kannst du oder lernst du schnell. Beides ist für uns okay. Du denkst in Zahlen (Triple Whale oder vergleichbar, MER, Post-Purchase-Survey) und triffst daraus Entscheidungen, keine Vermutungen. KI gehört zu deinem Alltag: Analysen, Korrelationen, Automationen. Nicht als Buzzword, als Werkzeug. Du bist penibel, aber nicht ängstlich. Skalierung braucht den Mut zu radikalen Budgetentscheidungen. Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und gutes Englisch. Nice-to-have: Native Ads (Taboola, Outbrain), CRO-Grundlagen und ein Gespür dafür, warum ein Creative funktioniert. Eine Sache sagen wir lieber jetzt als im Gespräch: Der Account wird jeden Tag geprüft. Auch samstags. Auch sonntags. Ein klassisches freies Wochenende gibt es in dieser Rolle nicht, dafür bist du sonst frei in deiner Zeiteinteilung. Wenn das für dich nicht passt, ist das völlig okay. Dann ist es nur nicht diese Stelle. Benefits Ein Account, mit dem du wirklich arbeiten kannst: rund 500.000 € Ad-Spend im Monat. Tendenz steigend. Echte Verantwortung ab Tag eins: Du fährst den Account eigenständig. Kein Freigabe-Pingpong. Klare Entwicklungsperspektive: Wer die Anlagen dafür hat, wächst bei uns Richtung Senior oder Head of Marketing. Gehalt nach Erfahrung (nach oben offen). 100 % Remote: Du arbeitest von wo du willst, solange du in Europa lebst und erreichbar bist. Flexible Arbeitszeit: Kein 9-to-5, keine Meeting-Kultur. Du teilst dir deinen Tag selbst ein, solange der Account täglich gecheckt ist. Direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung: Du sprichst mit den Leuten, die entscheiden. Technik-Setup deiner Wahl. Zugang zu Corporate Benefits. Ehrliches Feedback statt Nettigkeiten: Wir sagen dir, was gut ist und was nicht. Das bringt dich schneller weiter als höfliches Drumherumreden. Ein bis zwei Teamevents im Jahr. Klingt das nach dir? Dann brauchen wir kein Anschreiben, sondern Zahlen. Zeig uns: Welche Accounts hast du gesteuert, mit welchen Monatsbudgets, mit welchen Ergebnissen (NC-ROAS, MER, CPA)? Welches Sales-Event hast du selbst gefahren? Screenshots dürfen geschwärzt sein, das ist kein Problem. Praktisch: Deinen Lebenslauf lädst du unter „CV“ hoch. Alles andere (Zahlen, Screenshots, ein kurzes Wort zu dir) packst du ins Anschreiben-Feld (max. 10 MB). Wichtig: Bewerbungen ohne konkrete Accounts und Zahlen sortieren wir aus. Wir suchen hier einen Profi, und den erkennen wir an dem, was er gesteuert hat, nicht an dem, was er über sich schreibt. Wenn du dir vorher ein Bild von uns machen willst: Auf unserer Karriereseite lernst du das Team kennen und siehst, wie wir arbeiten. Tabea und das Valkental-Team freuen sich auf dich!   • Own the backend and integration layer for ground systems the services connecting operator tools, vehicles, sensors, and mission infrastructure

  • Design event-driven architectures and durable interface contracts so frontend, embedded, and partner systems can integrate and evolve safely

  • Build software that holds up in real operations, from telemetry pipelines to deployment, and follow problems across service boundaries end to end (including occasional lab or field support)

We care more about strong software engineers than checkbox perfection. If you meet most of these and are motivated to grow into the rest, please still apply tell us where you are strong and where you would ramp up.

Technical skills

  • Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience, plus 5+ years of commercial backend/platform development (no mission-domain background required)

  • Strong Python skills, it's the primary language for integration work on this team

  • Experience with service design, event-driven systems, async messaging, and evolving APIs without breaking consumers

  • Hands-on experience with contract-first interfaces: OpenAPI and Protocol Buffers

  • Track record building production APIs and real-time channels (REST, WebSockets, pub-sub)

  • Practical understanding of latency and performance trade-offs in system design

  • Comfortable with PostgreSQL, Redis, and choosing the right tool for the workload

  • Experience on Linux with Docker and CI/CD, with a solid grasp of HTTP servers and reverse proxies

  • Hands-on observability skills: structured logging, metrics, and production experience with Prometheus/Grafana

Soft Skills

  • Comfortable working in Scrum or similar agile teams

  • Strong software craftsmanship: testing, debugging distributed issues, code review, and clear communication in English (German a plus)

  • Ownership mindset, you follow problems across service boundaries and take responsibility for making integrations work end to end

Nice to Have

  • ROS 2 experience (nodes, topics, services) and familiarity with DDS/QoS

  • Deeper networking knowledge (TCP/IP, UDP, sockets) or hands-on work with Nginx/HAProxy

  • Time-series databases (e.g. InfluxDB) for high-frequency telemetry

  • Additional languages such as TypeScript/Node, Go, or C++

  • Familiarity with MAVLink or similar vehicle/telemetry protocols

  • Prior work in robotics, autonomous systems, defense, or industrial control software

  • Tech-lead or mentoring experience

  • Willingness to travel occasionally for on-site integration and test campaigns

Why TYTAN?

  • Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defence systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security

  • Shape scalable defence capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale

  • Contribute to networked air defence: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defence architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors

  • Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback

  • Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact

  • Define a new generation of defence technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company

  • Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us

  • Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team

  • Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together

  • Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands

  • Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

  • Define the simulation-specific security and access model, including ingress, TURN and STUN for WebRTC, RBAC, secrets management, SSO, and tenant boundaries

  • Solid knowledge of Linux, containers, and networking

  • Good Python skills for automation, services, and data-processing workflows

  • Very good English; German is a plus

Nice to have

title: Senior Rollout Manager (f/m/x) – DACH
description: Your mission IONITY baut ein europaweites Netzwerk von High-Power-Ladestationen auf und betreibt dieses. Als Senior Rollout Manager übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die erfolgreiche Umsetzung mehrerer Ladestandorte in der DACH-Region – von der Rollout-Planung und der Standortvorbereitung über die Bauphase, Inbetriebnahme und Abnahme bis zur Übergabe an Operations. Du überführst komplexe, funktionsübergreifende Projekte in einen planbaren und verlässlichen Rollout neuer Standorte. Die Rolle verbindet Projektmanagement, Infrastrukturentwicklung und Stakeholder-Management. Du koordinierst interne Teams, Behörden, Grundstückseigentümer, Netzbetreiber, Baufirmen, Installationspartner und spezialisierte Partner auf gemeinsame Meilensteine, Entscheidungen und Qualitätsstandards. Deine Arbeit leistet einen direkten Beitrag zum Wachstum des europäischen IONITY Netzwerks, sowie einem zuverlässigen Ladeerlebnis für Elektrofahrzeugfahrerinnen und -fahrer aus ganz Europa. Jede neue Ladesäule als Ergebnis deiner Arbeit beschleunigt die Verkehrswende und ist ein wichtiger Beitrag für eine emissionsfreie Mobilität. Du übernimmst die ganzheitliche Verantwortung für die Umsetzung eines Portfolios von HPC-Ladestandorten in der DACH-Region, mit besonderem Fokus auf die komplexesten, risikoreichsten oder strategisch wichtigsten Standorte. Über den gesamten Projektlebenszyklus hinweg steuerst du Umfang, Zeitplan, Abhängigkeiten, Risikoexponierung, Kostenrisiken, Qualität, Sicherheit, Compliance und die betriebliche Umsetzungsreife. Du übersetzt die Rollout-Ziele in integrierte Standort- und Portfolioumsetzungspläne, definierst Prioritäten, Reihenfolgen, Meilensteine und Abhängigkeiten und stellst eine klare Governance sicher – von der Standortentwicklung und Genehmigungsplanung über die Bauphase und Inbetriebnahme bis zur Übergabe an den Betrieb. Du führst die funktionsübergreifende Umsetzung über die Bereiche Planung und Genehmigung, Bau, Netzanschluss, Logistik etc. hinweg, treibst zeitnahe Entscheidungen voran, löst Konflikte und stellst sicher, dass kritische Schnittstellen zwischen Grundstück, Tiefbau, Elektrotechnik, Netzanschluss, Installation der Ladehardware, Prüfung und Inbetriebnahme aktiv gesteuert werden. Du steuerst externe Planungsbüros, Auftragnehmer, Installationsunternehmen und weitere Umsetzungspartner direkt, setzt klare Erwartungen, überwachst die Leistung, steuerst die operative Umsetzung sowie kommerzielle Risiken und stellst sicher, dass die Partner die vereinbarten Ergebnisse liefern. Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für das Risiko-, Änderungs- und Maßnahmenmanagement des Portfolios, identifizierst kritische Risiken frühzeitig, definierst Gegenmaßnahmen und führst Wiederherstellungspläne für verspätete, blockierte oder erheblich vom Plan abweichende Standorte. Dabei schützt du Umsetzungsqualität, Sicherheit und Compliance. Du triffst Entscheidungen innerhalb deines übertragenen Verantwortungs- und Entscheidungsrahmens und erstellst klare Entscheidungsvorlagen für den Country Manager DACH, sofern eine Eskalation erforderlich ist. Du stellst tragfähige Optionen, Auswirkungen und Empfehlungen dar und wägst dabei Zeitplan, Kosten, Qualität, technische Machbarkeit und die Anforderungen der Stakeholder gegeneinander ab. Du baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu Behörden, Netzbetreibern, Grundstückseigentümern, lokalen Stakeholdern und Umsetzungspartnern auf und pflegst diese, vertrittst IONITY auch in komplexen Gesprächen professionell und löst Genehmigungs-, Netzanschluss-, Grundstücks-, Bau- und sonstige Umsetzungshindernisse pragmatisch. Du erstellst prägnante und entscheidungsorientierte Berichte für Senior Stakeholder, einschließlich Fortschritt, prognostizierter Termine, Prognosesicherheit, wesentlicher Risiken, Kosten- und kommerzieller Risiken, Partnerleistung, Maßnahmen zur Planwiederherstellung sowie der erforderlichen Entscheidungen, um das Portfolio auf Kurs zu halten. Du etablierst und verbesserst kontinuierlich Rollout-Standards, Governance-Routinen, Vorlagen und Umsetzungsleitfäden. Auf Basis gewonnener Erkenntnisse erhöhst du die Planbarkeit, Qualität, Skalierbarkeit und Umsetzungseffektivität des Rollouts im gesamten DACH-Netzwerk. Your profile Du bist ein Teamplayer und arbeitest auch unter Zeitdruck mit einem hohen Anspruch an Qualität. Du verfügst über nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Leitung der Umsetzung komplexer Infrastruktur-, Bau-, Energie-, Mobilitäts-, Telekommunikations- oder vergleichbarer Rollout-Programme über mehrere Standorte hinweg, ideralerweise im Bereich HPC Ladeinfrastruktur. Du kannst eine Erfolgsbilanz bei der Übernahme von Ergebnisverantwortung über den gesamten Umsetzungslebenszyklus vorweisen – und nicht nur für einzelne Projektaufgaben oder Arbeitspakete. Du verfügst über ausgeprägte Kenntnisse in Programm- und Projektsteuerung, einschließlich integrierter Planung, Risikomanagement, Abhängigkeitsmanagement, Änderungssteuerung und Reporting auf Senior-Ebene. Du hast Erfahrung in der Steuerung externer Partner sowie in der Einflussnahme auf interne Stakeholder in einer Matrixorganisation. Du trittst sicher auf, stellst bestehende Ansätze konstruktiv infrage, triffst Entscheidungen und eskalierst Themen, wenn dies erforderlich ist. Du verfügst über ein fundiertes praktisches Verständnis der Schnittstellen zwischen Standortentwicklung, Genehmigungsplanung, Tiefbau, Elektrotechnik, Netzanschluss, Inbetriebnahme und Übergabe an den Betrieb. Du kommunizierst klar und strukturiert auf Deutsch und Englisch. Du besitzt einen gültigen Führerschein und bist bereit, regelmäßig mit Teams an den Standorten zusammenzuarbeiten. Du hast Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von Ladeinfrastruktur für Elektrofahrzeuge, Anlagen im Bereich erneuerbare Energien oder anderer dezentraler, kundenorientierter Infrastruktur. Du verfügst über etablierte Arbeitsbeziehungen zu Behörden, Netzbetreibern, Grundstückseigentümern und Baupartnern in einem oder mehreren DACH-Märkten. Du hast Erfahrung mit Schnittstellen zu Hochspannungs- oder elektrotechnischer Infrastruktur sowie mit der Inbetriebnahme und Übergabe in ein operatives Netzwerk. Du verfügst über gute Anwenderkenntnisse in AutoCAD und Microsoft Office, einschließlich fortgeschrittener Excel-Kenntnisse oder vergleichbarer Projektsteuerungs-Tools. Du hast ein einschlägiges Hochschulstudium, eine technische Qualifikation oder vergleichbare berufliche Erfahrung in den Bereichen Ingenieurwesen, Bauwesen, Infrastruktur oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet. title: Werkstudent Automatisierung, KI & Workflows im Enterprise Risk Management (m/w/d)
description: Dein neues Team: Du willst verstehen, wie ein modernes FinTech Risiken steuert und gleichzeitig mit Automatisierung und KI echte Prozessverbesserungen bauen? Im Enterprise Risk Management von auxmoney arbeitest Du in unserer GRC-Plattform (OneTrust) an Workflows, Integrationen und smarten, KI-gestützten Abläufen, die Risikomanagement effizienter und transparenter machen. Wir berichten direkt an den CFO und bündeln Themen wie Internes Kontrollsystem, operationelle Risiken, Incidents, Drittparteien sowie wiederkehrende Bestätigungen der Fachbereiche an einem zentralen Ort. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Team und den Fachbereichen zusammen, übernimmst früh Verantwortung und sorgst dafür, dass Informationen strukturiert erfasst, Aufgaben sauber verteilt und Statusdaten ohne manuelles Nachfassen ins Reporting fließen. Das erwartet Dich: Workflows konfigurieren: Du entwickelst Workflows in unserer GRC-Software OneTrust, von der Analyse des Ablaufs bis zur fertigen Konfiguration mit Datenfeldern, Statuslogiken, Verantwortlichkeiten, Eskalationen und automatischen Benachrichtigungen. Systeme integrieren: Du verbindest OneTrust über Schnittstellen und moderne Workflow-Tools mit weiteren Systemen bei auxmoney, zum Beispiel Slack, SharePoint oder Outlook, damit Fachbereiche Statusupdates dort liefern können, wo sie ohnehin arbeiten. Automatisierungen aufbauen: Du identifizierst wiederkehrende Handgriffe und ersetzt sie durch Automatisierungen, die Informationen anfordern, Aufgaben verteilen, Fristen überwachen und Folgeaktivitäten auslösen, etwa bei regelmäßigen Bestätigungen der Fachbereiche oder bei der Überprüfung unserer Dienstleister. Technisches Verständnis: Du hast Freude daran, neue Software zu verstehen, Workflows zu konfigurieren und technische Zusammenhänge zu durchdringen. Plus: Erfahrung mit Workflow-, Low-Code/No-Code-, Ticket- oder GRC-Systemen. Automatisierung und KI-Mindset: Du möchtest herausfinden, wie KI-Anwendungen und automatisierte Workflows das Risikomanagement verbessern, und hinterfragst Ergebnisse kritisch, statt Dich blind auf Vorschläge zu verlassen. Daten und Schnittstellen: Du denkst in Datenstrukturen und verstehst, wie Systeme über Schnittstellen miteinander sprechen. Plus: erste Kenntnisse in Excel, SQL, APIs oder Prozessmodellierung.   • Own the funnel from the first qualified conversation to signature. Our founders and Business Development open doors with customers, partners and the wider ecosystem. From there the opportunity is yours: you qualify it, drive it and close it, pulling the founders back in only when a deal needs them. Leads you generate yourself count just as much, this isn't exclusively BD's territory.
  • Qualify hard and early. Run discovery against a fixed gate (pain, budget, decision-making unit, timing) before we invest engineering time in a technical deep dive, and keep a clear next step with a date on every opportunity.
  • Lead the customer's buying team through a hardware buying cycle: end users, engineers, procurement, legal and IT, across long evaluations, equipment trials run as projects, integration questions and security reviews.
  • Orchestrate the deal team. Bring in our engineers and Field Application Engineers for demos, trials and technical deep dives, and Product Management for configuration and fit. You decide when a deal needs them and what they're there to do.
  • Own our active customers commercially: account plans, follow-on orders, upsells and expansion into new units and use cases, every escalation that touches the relationship, and regular account reviews with the Field Application Engineer who owns adoption.
  • Turn deployed systems into the next deal: reference visits, customer quotes and case material that you or the founders can use to open new accounts.
  • Own the offer: configuration and pricing, terms and conditions, the cost-benefit case on the customer's own data, and the project plan to signature. Lead our responses to RFPs and tenders where they apply, and build the templates so every proposal starts from a proven base.

In just five years, Stora has become the platform behind more than 30% of UK self storage locations, and we're scaling globally from here. Operators have processed over £150m in automated payments through us, and see an average of 32% business growth after they switch.

We're doing this in a market that's wide open. Europe has over 10,000 self storage sites and is growing fast, yet it sits years behind the US on maturity and is still barely touched by good software. The UK is our stronghold. The rest of Europe is where we're heading next.

Stora is the operating system for modern self storage: online bookings, payments, facility management, reporting, and automation in one platform. We started as operators ourselves, and that's still how we think. If you want to own a product operators depend on every day, in a company genuinely rethinking how it builds, this is it.

Why this role matters

We have a strong product team, great engineers, and a growing product. The bottleneck isn't ideas or execution capacity. It's people who can hold the full picture at once.

What the business needs, what the customer actually experiences, what's technically feasible, what to cut when time is short, and knowing when to slow down. Making good calls across all of it. That's the job.

We've shortened the loop between insight and shipped product by stripping out the layers that slow good judgement down. The quality bar didn't move. This role exists to keep doing that. It carries real ownership from day one, and the scope grows as Stora does.

The surface you'd own

This is the product operators live in every day, and the storefront their own customers book through. You're designing for two users at once: the operator running the business, and the end customer renting the unit. Getting that B2B2C experience right is a genuine craft problem. It's a broad, central surface, and it's heavy on UX.

Concretely, the surface includes:

  • Core workflows: customers, units, tenancies, access

  • Roles, permissions, account structure

  • Operational reporting: occupancy, utilisation, activity

  • The internal data layer: event tracking, core models, metric definitions

  • The growth surface: storefront, checkout, the lead → booking funnel

If an operator uses it daily, or relies on it to understand their business, it sits with this team.

How we actually work

We've changed how product gets built at Stora. This is how we operate now.

Designers work directly in the codebase. Engineers and product people work closely together from the start. We use AI genuinely: to explore, prototype and move faster. The work gets closer to reality, sooner.

If you're at a company that talks about moving faster but runs the same process it did three years ago, this will feel different. We're not done evolving how we work, and this person will have real scope to shape that.

What you'll do

  • Own a problem space end-to-end, from understanding the customer need to something live in the product

  • Work across both sides of the experience: operator back office and end-customer storefront

  • Work directly with engineering leads. Close collaboration, not handoff

  • Make scope calls. Know what to cut, what's fundamental, what can wait

  • Work with or without a designer, depending on the problem. What matters is the outcome

  • Stay close to customers, talk to operators, understand how they run their businesses, bring that into every decision

  • Shape how we work. The process isn't fixed. If something's slowing things down, fix it

What you'll bring

  • Real product experience at a SaaS company. You've owned features or problem spaces end-to-end and shipped things people use. Roughly 2+ years, though we care more about the evidence than the number

  • A builder by instinct. You make things: side projects, tools, a company you tried to start. We'd rather see someone who ships than someone who only plans

  • A design or engineering past works too. You may have come from design, engineering, or somewhere else entirely. Designers and people who've started their own things tend to do well here

  • Great product taste. You can tell the difference between a solution that works and one that just ships

  • You define it yourself. You don't need everything defined to make progress

  • Real design sense. Strong enough to contribute or push back, which matters a lot on a surface this UX-heavy

  • AI-native. You use AI as a natural part of how you think and work. Not waiting to be shown how

This role is not for you if

  • You need a detailed brief before you can start

  • You've only ever worked inside someone else's process and haven't shipped anything of your own

  • You think good product work stops before it ships

  • You go quiet when a problem is ambiguous instead of pushing into it

Why Stora

  • A category-defining surface to own. Self storage software is wide open, and the core experience is the heart of it. You set the direction here, you don't inherit it.

  • Work that ships, and that you feel. We've stripped out the layers between insight and shipped product. What you build reaches operators in weeks, not quarters.

  • A team that builds differently. Designers in the codebase, AI used for real, process that bends when it should. Small team, outsized impact.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary

  • Share options

  • Remote across the UK & Europe, or hybrid from our Belfast office

  • 35 days holiday

  • Private health insurance (for you + family)

  • Company pension plan

  • Apple hardware

  • Learning & development support

Next steps

When you apply, we'll ask for a link to something you've made — a product, a side project, a repo, a tool you built because something annoyed you. It doesn't need to be polished, successful, or related to storage. We just want to see that you build. Please include one.

title: Founding Tech Lead (Dual Use Defence & Health-tech) - Tricorder
description: Build the operating system for healthcare beyond the hospital Most healthcare technology assumes a hospital: reliable power, connectivity, a data centre down the corridor and a clinician at a desk. Care increasingly happens somewhere else - in the field, in transit, in remote and contested environments, and in the critical minutes before a patient ever reaches a ward. Tricorder is building the deployable clinical infrastructure for that world: a rugged, self-contained hardware and software platform for clinical teams to capture, monitor and act on patient data anywhere, even when networking or the grid can't be relied on. We are building this from scratch inside Founders Factory's studio, with a dedicated pre-seed investment, hands-on studio support across product, design, talent and growth, and a six-month build programme to get from concept to a fundable, in-market product. This venture has secured a major European industrial partner to provide hardware, sandbox testing, RnD capabilities. The founding CEO is already in place. We are now looking for the technical other half of the founding team. The role You will be the founding Tech Lead. This is a builder's role before it becomes a management role. In the early studio days you will be hands-on across hardware and software, making pragmatic architectural calls under real uncertainty, and turning a concept and early customer conversations into a working, demonstrable product. You'll work hand in hand with the founder & CEO on product direction, pilot deployments, and technical documentation for future funding rounds. You will be responsible for defining the initial technology stack and building the core engineering team. What you'll own You will have end-to-end responsibility for: System Integration: Working with integrated sensing, edge computing, and building out data synchronization layers to complete an OS. Architectural Design: Building resilient systems for environments with intermittent connectivity and power constraints. Regulatory Compliance: Ensuring alignment with medical device regulations, data protection standards, and quality management frameworks. Product Validation: Delivering functional prototypes for clinical pilots and investor demonstrations. Team Leadership: Recruiting and managing the initial engineering team as the company scales. What we're looking for We're looking for a rare combination: someone who can build hardware and regulated software together, and who wants to do it as a founder rather than an employee. Strong candidates will bring most of the following: A track record of shipping real products , ideally spanning both physical devices and the software that runs on and around them. You’ve taken something from prototype to something people actually use, not just research or internal demos. Depth in one or more of: embedded systems / firmware, sensors and signal acquisition, edge compute, or connected-device architecture. Experience building in a regulated, high-trust domain : health-tech, medical devices, defence, or a comparable safety-critical field, and comfort with the standards and evidence that come with it (e.g. clinical safety, data protection, medical-device / quality management frameworks). Pragmatism and speed at the earliest stage : you make good build-vs-buy calls, ship, and are comfortable with ambiguity and imperfect information. Founder wiring : you want ownership and equity, you can carry the technical story with clinical users and investors, and you can hire and raise the bar without slowing everyone down. A reason to care : something you've seen, built or lived that makes this problem feel important and solvable to you. Nice to have Advanced knowledge of AI/ML for on-device inference or sensor fusion. Experience as a founding engineer or early employee at a technology startup. Exposure to clinical, pre-hospital, emergency, humanitarian or field-operations environments. Familiarity with the realities of getting hardware manufactured and certified. Pre-existing security clearance with UKSV Probably not the right fit if Your experience is mostly software-only, or mostly hardware-only, and you're not excited to work across the seam of the two. You've worked mainly inside large organisations with mature processes and large teams, and need that structure to be effective. You want to design the perfect architecture before understanding the users, the constraints and the regulatory path. You're looking for a senior IC or corporate CTO title rather than a genuine co-founder role at pre-seed pace. Why build with Founders Factory Founders Factory provides structured support through a dedicated studio team specializing in product, design, and growth. This role offers co-founder equity and a stipend during the six-month build phase, positioning the CTO for a long-term leadership role in the resulting company. As part of your application, we'd love to know What have you seen, experienced, or learned that makes you believe this problem is both important and solvable? What unique advantage, experience, network, or insight do you bring that would give you an edge in building this company? What are the three most important milestones you would achieve during our six-month studio build programme, and why? Compensation: Founder-level stipend during the studio build programme + significant founding tech lead equity with standard vesting. Security clearance: Parts of our work will sit in national-security-adjacent settings. Candidates should be willing and able to undergo UK government security vetting if not already held.   • Product Validation: Delivering functional prototypes for clinical pilots and investor demonstrations.

  • Team Leadership: Recruiting and managing the initial engineering team as the company scales.

What we're looking for

We're looking for a rare combination: someone who can build hardware and regulated software together, and who wants to do it as a founder rather than an employee.

Strong candidates will bring most of the following:

  • A track record of shipping real products, ideally spanning both physical devices and the software that runs on and around them. You’ve taken something from prototype to something people actually use, not just research or internal demos.

Die AWP Wirtschaftstreuhand GmbH ist Mitglied des Netzwerkverbunds der LKC, welchem über 30 Kanzleien deutschlandweit angehören. Die gesuchte Person wird deshalb nicht nur für die AWP als Arbeitgeber tätig sein, sondern soll im Rahmen der gesamten LKC-Gruppe ihre fachliche Kompetenz auftrags- und fallbezogen einbringen können.

Wer wir sind und was uns ausmacht.

Wir in der LKC-Gruppe bieten unseren Mandanten eine ganzheitliche Beratung in allen steuerlichen und betriebswirtschaftlichen Belangen. Als Kanzleiverbund setzen wir dabei auf digitale und effiziente Prozesse und nutzen aktiv die Chancen der Digitalisierung. Damit schaffen wir mehr Zeit für unsere Mandanten und abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben rund um die Gestaltungsberatung. Trotz des Leistungsangebots und Mandaten, wie man sie eher in Großkanzleien findet, kennen wir bei LKC unsere Kollegen persönlich und unterstützen uns gegenseitig mit unseren individuellen Stärken und Kenntnissen.

Aufgaben

Ihre Aufgaben.

Als Gestaltungsberater für Restrukturierung und Unternehmensnachfolge erwartet Sie ein spannendes und herausforderndes Tätigkeitsfeld. Als steuerlicher Experte erarbeiten Sie in engem Austausch mit dem jeweiligen mandatsverantwortlichen Partner individuelle Gestaltungskonzepte und begleiten deren Umsetzung bis zum Abschluss. Maßgeschneiderte Lösungen und Strategien werden von Ihnen entwickelt, um Unternehmen in sensiblen Umstellungsphasen erfolgreich zu begleiten. Sie führen unsere Mandanten durch steuerliche und rechtliche Herausforderungen und unterstützen sie als vertrauensvoller Partner. Hierbei fungieren Sie als standortübergreifender Berater der LKC-Gruppe. Ihren beruflichen Sitz hätten Sie je nach Ihrer privaten und familiären Orientierung in einer unserer Partnerkanzleien in Regensburg (AWP), Augsburg (GRP Günter Reitmayer GmbH & Co. KG) oder München. Ihre Beratungsaufträge werden dabei durch Kanzleien der LKC-Gruppe generiert, sodass Sie auch überregionale Aufträge bearbeiten werden, jedoch mit Schwerpunkt im süddeutschen Raum. In dieser Rolle können Sie Ihre Expertise in einem dynamischen Umfeld einsetzen und sich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln.

Unter anderem erwarten Sie folgende Tätigkeiten:

  • Erstellung und operative Umsetzung von Umwandlungen, Restrukturierungen sowie der Nachfolgeberatung
  • Steuerrechtliche Beratung bei der Unternehmensnachfolge und Begleitung bei der Ausarbeitung der erforderlichen Verträge und weiteren rechtlichen Maßnahmen
  • Erstellung von Gutachten und Stellungnahmen

Qualifikation

Ihr Profil.

Sie sind ein Teamplayer und finden sich in folgenden Punkten wieder? Dann freuen wir uns, Sie bei der LKC willkommen zu heißen.

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Steuerberaterexamen und/oder zweites juristisches Staatsexamen
  • Idealerweise mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung als Steuerberater und/oder Rechtsanwalt in der Gestaltungsberatung
  • Fundiertes steuerliches, betriebswirtschaftliches und juristisches Wissen mit Fokus auf dem Umwandlungs(steuer)recht und Erbschaftsteuerrecht
  • Engagierte, unternehmerische und selbständige Arbeitsweise
  • DATEV- und MS-Office-Kenntnisse wünschenswert
  • Kommunikative Persönlichkeit und Freude am Austausch mit Mandanten

Benefits

Unser Versprechen.

Wir glauben, dass eine erfolgreiche Zusammenarbeit stets auf einem Geben und Nehmen basiert und sind uns dessen bewusst, dass unsere Mitarbeiter der Grundstein unseres Erfolges sind. Deshalb geben wir gerne etwas (mehr) zurück und bieten Ihnen neben einem entsprechend der Stellenanforderung überdurchschnittlichen Gehalt weitere Benefits, wie:

  • Umfassende Fort- und Weiterbildungsangebote, denn Ihre Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten inkl. flexibles Home-Office, damit Berufs- und Privatleben unter denselben Hut passen
  • Ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld und frei wählbare Ausstattung
  • Spannende Teamevents
  • Fitnessangebote
  • Parkplätze vor Ort, Firmenvergünstigungen, Getränke und vieles mehr
  • LKC ist einmalig – und über 30-malig in Deutschland – beraten wir mit Leidenschaft, Kompetenz und Charme

Wie es weiter geht.

Sie haben Lust auf abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben rund um Gestaltungsberatung und weiteren vielseitigen Tätigkeiten in einem persönlichen Umfeld?

Wir bei LKC vereinen das Beste aus diesen zwei Welten und freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

title: Senior Strategic Consultant Professional Services
description: Contentsquare is the all-in-one experience intelligence platform designed to be easily used by anyone who cares about digital journeys. With our flexible and scalable platform, organizations quickly get a deep understanding of their customers’ whole online journey. We are a global leader in the experience analytics space, with a growing presence across 15 offices worldwide. We’re here to stay—and we’re looking for team members who are excited to drive impact and help us scale even further. Our aim is to create an inclusive workplace where everyone learns and succeeds. Contentsquare has built a community of individuals who are daring, understanding, and deliberate. We invite you to join us in making the complex simpler—for our customers, their customers, and each other. Important note: Be careful of scammers pretending to be from Contentsquare. We will never ask for money or contact you through random texts. Any communication from our in house Talent Acquisition team will only ever come from our contentsquare.com or ----- domain. For more information, visit our careers blog. About the job The Professional Services team helps Contentsquare customers turn digital experience data into measurable business outcomes. As a Senior Strategic Consultant, you will be a senior, client-facing consultant responsible for delivering strategic, analytical, and enablement services to enterprise customers. You will combine consulting expertise, project management, digital analytics knowledge, and Contentsquare expertise to help customers understand their digital experience, prioritize opportunities, and take action. You will work across two types of engagements: One-off consulting missions, where you lead and deliver a defined project (analysis, workshop, training..) Managed-services engagements, where you act as the delivery owner and project manager for an ongoing customer relationship. You will manage the service roadmap, coordinate contributors, maintain delivery momentum, and proactively ensure that the customer receives value from the available services. You will operate as a trusted advisor to customer teams, including operational stakeholders, analytics teams, technical teams, and senior or economic buyers. You will work closely with Customer Success Manager and Sales but also all your Professional Services colleagues such as Data Analysts, UX Design Consultants, Implementation Managers, Training Consultants.. This role is ideal for someone who combines the structure and client leadership of a senior consultant with the curiosity and practical fluency of a digital analytics power user. What you’ll do Own the delivery of strategic consulting and analytics engagements from discovery through completion. Act as the primary operational point of contact for the services being delivered to the customer. Define project objectives, scope, milestones, working methods, deliverables, and success criteria. Build and manage delivery plans, priorities, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations. Lead managed-services engagements as the delivery owner and project manager. Maintain a proactive service roadmap and identify the right missions, workshops, analyses, training sessions, and enablement activities for each customer. Coordinate the work of Data Analysts, UX Design Consultants, Implementation Managers, Training Consultants, and other specialists when required. Escalate delivery risks, scope issues, capacity constraints, or customer blockers in a timely manner. Ensure that customers receive measurable value from their Professional Services engagement. Apply digital analytics and Contentsquare expertise Analyze digital experience data and translate findings into clear business insights and actionable recommendations. Prepare and deliver analyses, executive readouts, workshops, training sessions, and working sessions with customer teams. Help customers define use cases, measurement approaches, prioritization frameworks, and roadmaps. Assess data collection, tagging plans, data quality, measurement frameworks, and the conditions required for reliable analysis. Use Contentsquare and other digital analytics tools to investigate customer questions and support evidence-based decisions. Understand how digital analytics data can connect with broader customer data ecosystems, including business intelligence tools, data warehouses, data lakes, APIs, and activation platforms. You are not expected to be a specialist Data Analyst or Data Architect, but you should be comfortable working with data and explaining analytical findings to both business and technical stakeholders. Partner with customers and internal teams Facilitate discussions with operational teams, analytics teams, technical stakeholders, senior leaders, and economic buyers. Work closely with the Customer Success Manager. The CSM owns the broader partnership, while you own the quality, coordination, and delivery of the services provided. Collaborate across the broader Professional Services organization and contribute your expertise to team discussions, methods, and delivery standards. Build trusted relationships with enterprise customers and become a reliable advisor on their digital experience and analytics priorities. Communicate complex analytical or technical concepts clearly to audiences with different levels of expertise. Identify risks and opportunities Monitor customer adoption, engagement, delivery progress, and stakeholder participation. Proactively identify risks such as declining adoption, missed milestones, unclear ownership, or limited use of the platform. Surface relevant expansion or cross-sell opportunities to the Customer Success and Sales teams. This is not a quota-carrying sales role, but you are expected to recognize when additional Contentsquare capabilities or services could address a customer need. Identify opportunities to improve customer processes, measurement practices, data flows, or use of digital analytics. Improve how we work Contribute to reusable consulting methods, frameworks, templates, and points of view. Use artificial intelligence responsibly to improve preparation, analysis, delivery quality, and internal processes. Stay current with developments in digital analytics, artificial intelligence, data ecosystems, and customer experience measurement. Share knowledge with other consultants and help strengthen the capabilities of the wider Professional Services team. What you’ll need to succeed Approximately 5 to 6 years of experience in management consulting, strategic consulting, digital consulting, professional services, or a similar customer-facing advisory environment. Experience working with large enterprise customers and navigating complex stakeholder environments. Demonstrated experience managing projects or workstreams from discovery through delivery. Strong client-facing communication and presentation skills, including the ability to lead workshops and executive discussions. Structured thinking and strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to frame ambiguous customer challenges clearly. Practical experience with digital analytics, business intelligence, conversion optimization, customer experience analytics, or related data products. Familiarity with digital analytics platforms such as Google Analytics or Adobe Analytics. Experience with Contentsquare is highly valuable. Understanding of tagging plans, data collection, data quality, measurement frameworks, data structures, and the limitations that can affect analytical outcomes. Ability to interpret data, develop an analysis, and communicate the implications and recommendations clearly. Ability to work effectively with both business and technical stakeholders. Strong project management skills, including planning, prioritization, risk management, stakeholder coordination, and escalation. Ability to work independently across a changing mix of one-off missions and recurring managed-services engagements. Comfortable collaborating with Customer Success, Sales, Data Analysts, UX Design Consultants, Implementation Managers, and other specialist teams. Practical curiosity about artificial intelligence, data flows, data warehouses, data lakes, APIs, and modern digital analytics ecosystems. Ability to use AI tools thoughtfully to improve your own work and customer delivery, while applying appropriate judgment and maintaining confidentiality. Full professional fluency in French and English, including the ability to lead customer conversations, workshops, and presentations in French. Availability to work with customers primarily during French or Central European business hours. Willingness to travel occasionally for customer engagements, team meetings, and company events. Why you should join Contentsquare We invest in our people through career development, mentorship, social events, philanthropic activities, and competitive benefits. We are always assessing the perks we offer to ensure we’re aligned with the employees' needs. Here are a few we want to highlight: - Virtual onboarding, Hackathon, and various opportunities to interact with your team and global colleagues both on and offsite each year - Work flexibility: hybrid and remote work policies - Generous paid time-off policy (every location is different) - Lifestyle allowance - A Culture Crew in every country we’re based in to coordinate regular activities for employees to get to know each other and bond outside of work - Every full-time employee receives stock options, allowing them to share in the company’s success - We have multiple Employee Resource Groups, that offer a safe space for individuals who share common identities, life experiences, or allyship to connect, support one another, and passionately advocate for the issues close to their hearts - And more benefits tailored to each country Contentsquare is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. Your personal data is used by Contentsquare for recruitment purposes only. Read our Job Candidate Privacy Notice to find out more about data protection at Contentsquare and your rights. You can exercise your rights by using our dedicated Data Subject Rights Portal here . Your personal data will be securely stored in our hosting provider’s data center in Oregon (US west). We have implemented appropriate transfer mechanisms under applicable data protection laws. Contentsquare may use AI-assisted tools to help review and screen applications. All decisions involving hiring are made by human reviewers, and your personal data will be processed in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy . title: Senior Account Manager
description: Caseware is one of Canada's original Fintech companies, having led the global audit and accounting software industry for over 30 years, with more than 500,000 users across 130 countries and available in 16 different languages. While you might not have heard of us (yet) over 36,000 accounting and audit professionals list Caseware as a skill on their LinkedIn profiles! As a Senior Account Manager you will be the face of Caseware to some of our most important accounting clients and you will need to demonstrate strong relationship marketing skills. With the support of colleagues, you will manage the relationship at some of our most important accounting firm clients, initially managing 30+ firms/offices. Using strong consultative selling skills, you will balance maximise sales opportunities while also partnering closely with internal stakeholders to achieve team goals and work towards Caseware’s mission plan. You will also work closely with the International Strategic Account team, Account Executives and the Caseware Marketing team to develop an ongoing engagement strategy through regular client service activity, represent the CaseWare brand and suite of products at trade events, building rapport, and ultimately closing sales opportunities, whilst expanding revenue amongst our current client base. The role will require travel in the UK and Ireland. Having a car and a valid driving licence is a hard requirement. You will be reporting to: Ricky Mahary, Sales Manager Practice Sector Shez Hamill, Senior Sales Director UK & Ireland What you will do: • Create and maintain account plans for all assigned clients. • Create and maintain a diary of regular client service visits and meetings to ensure that we regularly exceed our clients expectations. • Achieve the reasonably set annual sales targets (never to be lower than £250,000). Proficiently demonstrate the features, benefits and capabilities of our various product offerings. • Assist in the delivery of regular marketing activity in your territory, including attending events, conducting webinars etc. • As a result of the above, to achieve agreed monthly and annual sales targets. • Utilize all sales technologies, deepen the industry knowledge, and stay on top of the developments in the industry. • Ensure that CRM records are accurate, informative and up to date for the sales territory under your management and that sales procedures are followed. • Manage own ‘hot list’ tasks. • Provide accurate sales pipeline and forecast information on a regular basis. • Handling of any sales enquiries and ensure that enquiries are answered swiftly and professionally. • Preparation of sales seminars. • Assist in preparation of any marketing resources required to support campaign activity. • Support colleagues during absence, mentor junior team members when appropriate and contribute to the “one team” ethic of the sales team. What you will bring: • Comfortable in growth mode of sales. We are in the building stages of our new sales organization and you will be an important member of this next evolution of our sales team. • Proven track record of success in Software, SaaS, ERP, and/or Tech Sales. • Previous sales experience and success in selling and winning new business opportunities. • Experience building a territory and executing a territory plan. • Consistent achievement of sales quota. • Excellent verbal and written communication skills. • Knowledge of forecasting revenue levels and achieving sales targets in a high-growth environment. • Knowledge of the accounting profession is highly valued but not absolutely required. Your contributions directly affect how our clients manage financial processes and drive their success. ▪️Recognition and rewards matter to us . Work on international projects and collaborate with a diverse, global team. raw.title: Senior Electrical Characterisation Engineer
raw.description:
About The Role and Team

Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing scale-up based in London founded by internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University with over 40 years’ experience in developing qubits and quantum computing architectures. Bringing together state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities and an outstanding interdisciplinary team, we are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence and more.


Our Team


Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times in 2021 and 2022, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph, BBC and the New Statesman. Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million.

 

We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology.

 

This is a rare and exciting opportunity to be an employee at a scale-up shaping the future of quantum computing. There are vast opportunities for professional growth and to make an impact within the company. 

Our team of 100+ is based across London, Oxford, San Sebastián and Sydney, with our primary hub in Islington (London).

We are looking for a Senior Electrical Characterisation Engineer to join our Process Integration team and play a key role in understanding, qualifying and improving the silicon devices at the heart of our quantum processors.

You will sit at a fascinating intersection between semiconductor manufacturing and quantum hardware, working closely with foundries, process engineers and quantum engineers.

You will use electrical characterisation and large-scale data analysis to understand manufacturing variability, identify the root causes of device behaviour, and feed those insights directly back into the semiconductor fabrication process.

This is an opportunity to have a tangible impact on the yield, quality and scalability of quantum processors, working with some of the most advanced silicon technology being developed for quantum computing.


Functions of the Role

  • Drive electrical characterisation of fabricated silicon devices, developing and continuously improving high-throughput screening methods to assess key device parameters including threshold voltage, gate oxide reliability and channel mobility.

  • Turn electrical data into manufacturing insight, identifying patterns, variability and device failures and connecting them back to semiconductor process steps such as photolithography, etching, oxide growth, CMP and doping.

  • Develop automated measurement and test infrastructure, creating robust Python-based test routines and instrument-control workflows across room-temperature and, where appropriate, low-temperature wafer probing environments.

  • Analyse large-scale electrical datasets using statistical process control, yield analysis and other data-driven techniques to monitor wafer uniformity, defect density and process drift.

  • Work directly with semiconductor foundries and process engineers, providing clear, actionable feedback that can be used to improve device performance, consistency and yield.

  • Build scalable characterisation processes, establishing testing standards, calibration procedures, SOPs and data pipelines that allow information to flow effectively between semiconductor process integration and quantum engineering teams.

  • Help shape how we characterise the next generation of our technology, bringing your expertise and ideas to continuously improve our measurement capability as Quantum Motion scales.

  • We are looking for someone who combines strong semiconductor device knowledge with a practical, data-driven approach to electrical characterisation.


Experience - Essentials


  • Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Semiconductor Physics, Materials Science or a closely related discipline.

  • 3+ years' experience in semiconductor device testing, reliability engineering, electrical characterisation or yield analysis within a foundry, IDM or semiconductor R&D environment.

  • Strong understanding of silicon CMOS fabrication processes, semiconductor device physics and foundry workflows.

  • Hands-on experience with semiconductor parameter analysers, SMUs and wafer probe stations, including DC and/or RF electrical testing.

  • Strong Python skills, particularly for instrument control, automation and automated test execution.

  • A highly analytical approach and the ability to work with large datasets to identify trends, anomalies and root causes.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across semiconductor, process, hardware and quantum engineering teams.


Experience - Desirable

It would be particularly valuable if you also have experience in:

  • Quantum device physics, including quantum dots, single-electron transistors (SETs) or charge-stability mapping.

  • Cryogenic electrical characterisation and low-temperature measurement systems.

  • Semiconductor yield improvement, process control or statistical analysis.

  • Automated wafer-level testing and high-throughput characterisation.

  • Working with advanced or emerging semiconductor technologies.


Benefits

  • Competitive salary and share options scheme

  • Contributory pension scheme

  • Group private medical insurance scheme

  • Life Assurance

  • Cycle-to-work Scheme 

  • Central London location

description: Who are we? At UpGuard, we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process 100 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk. We build the Cyber Risk Posture Management (CRPM) platform that security teams actually love. By integrating security ratings, threat intel, and agentic AI, we empower organisations to stay ahead of an ever evolving attack surface. We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale. About the role We're hiring a Software Engineer to join our Product Engineering team. You'll work across the whole stack: customer-facing features in React and TypeScript, Go services that process security data at internet scale, and the plumbing that keeps it all secure and reliable. You'll ship real work in your first weeks with a senior engineer as your buddy, and your scope will grow as you're ready for it. You don't need to know cybersecurity yet, but you do need to be curious about it. You'll join one of our 11 (and growing) Product Engineering squads, most of which have a product manager, designer and technical lead alongside the engineers. Our stack is React and TypeScript on the front end, Go services with Postgres as our primary database, running on Kubernetes via Google Cloud Platform. Our engineers work with agentic coding tools, mostly Claude Code and Cursor, and a growing part of the product is LLM-backed. You'll work this way from day one, and we'll want your ideas on what to automate next, from how we write code to how we test, review, ship and run it. Cybersecurity experience Running services on Kubernetes, ideally on GCP What's in it for you? raw.jobDescription:
Who are we?

At UpGuard, we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process 100 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk.

We build the Cyber Risk Posture Management (CRPM) platform that security teams actually love. By integrating security ratings, threat intel, and agentic AI, we empower organisations to stay ahead of an ever evolving attack surface.

We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale.

About the role

We're hiring a Software Engineer to join our Product Engineering team. You'll work across the whole stack: customer-facing features in React and TypeScript, Go services that process security data at internet scale, and the plumbing that keeps it all secure and reliable. You'll ship real work in your first weeks with a senior engineer as your buddy, and your scope will grow as you're ready for it. You don't need to know cybersecurity yet, but you do need to be curious about it.

You'll join one of our 11 (and growing) Product Engineering squads, most of which have a product manager, designer and technical lead alongside the engineers.

Our stack is React and TypeScript on the front end, Go services with Postgres as our primary database, running on Kubernetes via Google Cloud Platform.

Our engineers work with agentic coding tools, mostly Claude Code and Cursor, and a growing part of the product is LLM-backed. You'll work this way from day one, and we'll want your ideas on what to automate next, from how we write code to how we test, review, ship and run it.

What you'll do

  • Build and ship customer-facing features across our React front end and Go services

  • Own well-scoped work end to end, with senior engineers to pair with and review your designs

  • Help keep the platform fast and reliable as we scale

  • Give and receive thoughtful code review and join the technical discussions that shape how we build

  • Go deep on the cybersecurity domain; it's one of the best parts of the job

  • Grow toward senior, with increasing scope as you're ready and a manager focused on getting you there

What we're looking for

  • Typically 2+ years of relevant engineering experience

  • Strong TypeScript and React

  • A backend language you're productive in (we use Go)

  • Solid relational database skills (we use Postgres)

  • AI coding tools as your default workflow, and the judgment to review and own what they produce

  • Pragmatic trade-offs: you weigh technical quality against what the business needs now

  • Low ego, high care: you're in it for the product and the customer, not just the code

What will give you an edge?

  • Cybersecurity experience

  • Running services on Kubernetes, ideally on GCP

What's in it for you?

We're fully remote, and we'd rather spend on things people actually use than on perks that look good in a job ad.

  • Fully remote and flexible: work from anywhere in Australia. We have offices in Sydney and Hobart, a co-working allowance everywhere else, and no attendance mandate.

  • Real face time: two off-sites a year, one with your squad and one with the wider Product team or the whole company, plus city-based socials in between, with colleagues who like spending time together.

  • Stock options: every engineer gets equity, so you share in UpGuard's growth.

  • Annual leave: PTO plus two additional UpGuardian leave days to give you time to recharge your batteries.

  • 18 weeks paid Parental Leave: irrespective of parenting role (all regions)

  • Personal Leave allowance: this includes sick and carer’s leave.

  • $[amount] monthly lifestyle subsidy for your financial, physical and mental wellbeing.

  • US$1,500 annual learning and development allowance, spent on whatever helps your career, not just courses.

  • WFH set-up allowance to get your home office right in your first three months.

UpGuard is a Certified Great Place to Work® in the US, Australia, UK and India, establishing its position as a leading global technology employer. 99% of team members agree that UpGuard is a great place to work! Apply now to find out why!

title: Senior Manager SEA (m/w/d)
description: Werde Teil eines starken Teams bei emetriq! emetriq, Teil der Deutschen Telekom AG, bietet datengetriebene Online-Advertising-Lösungen und setzt sich für fairen Datenzugang als Treibstoff für Innovation und Vielfalt ein. Mit unserer Expertise und Technologiekompetenz steigern wir die Präzision und Relevanz von Online-Werbung. Als Initiatoren des größten kollaborativen Datenpools in Deutschland vereinen wir über 100 Data- und Mediaexperten. Im Team Magenta fungieren wir zudem als exklusive Programmatic & Paid Social Media Agentur für die Deutsche Telekom. Von Awareness bis Performance: Wir entwickeln digitale Mediapläne und steuern Kampagnen entlang des gesamten Marketing Funnels. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir in Bonn oder Hamburg ab sofort einen Senior Manager SEA (m/w/d) in Vollzeit. In dieser übergreifenden Rolle arbeitest du für unseren Kunden die Deutsche Telekom im Privatkundenbereich und verbindest operatives SEA-Verständnis mit strategischer Beratung und einem Fokus auf Performance-Marketing. Du steuerst unsere SEA-Maßnahmen fachlich, hinterfragst bestehende Kampagnenstrukturen und Prozesse und entwickelst sie gemeinsam mit den operativen Kampagnenteams weiter, um Conversion, Effizienz und Wachstum nachhaltig zu steigern. Wie du uns helfen kannst Fachliche Steuerung der Umsetzung: Du übersetzt strategische Performance-Ziele in klare Anforderungen, priorisierst Maßnahmen und begleitest die operative Umsetzung im Austausch mit beteiligten Partner:innen und Fachbereichen. Übergreifende SEA-Verantwortung: Du steuerst performanceorientierte SEA-Maßnahmen übergreifend und sorgst dafür, dass Ziele, Planung, operative Umsetzung und Optimierung wirksam ineinandergreifen. Operative Qualitätssicherung: Du prüfst Account- und Kampagnenstrukturen, Keywords, Anzeigen, Zielgruppen, Budgets und Gebotsstrategien und bewertest, ob die Umsetzung die definierten Performance-Ziele unterstützt. Analyse und Weiterentwicklung: Du analysierst Performance-Daten, hinterfragst bestehende Maßnahmen und Prozesse und entwickelst konkrete Verbesserungsansätze zur Steigerung von Effizienz, Conversion und Wachstum. Strategische Beratung: Du berätst interne Stakeholder zu Kampagnenarchitektur, Keyword- und Budgetstrategien, Automatisierung, Messbarkeit und kanalübergreifenden Fragestellungen mit Schwerpunkt auf Performance-Marketing. Dabei führst du bestehende Maßnahmen und Prozesse nicht einfach unreflektiert fort, sondern hinterfragst sie konstruktiv und optimierst oder entwickelst sie gezielt weiter. Testing und Innovation: Du entwickelst neue Testansätze für Kampagnentypen, Anzeigen, Landingpages, Zielgruppen und Gebotsstrategien und bewertest gemeinsam mit den Kampagnenteams deren Wirkung auf Conversion, Effizienz und Skalierung. Kanalübergreifende Perspektive und Tracking: Du betrachtest SEA im Zusammenspiel mit weiteren Kanälen und entwickelst daraus integrierte Empfehlungen entlang der Kommunikations- und Performance-Ziele. Präsentation und Stakeholder-Management: Du bereitest Ergebnisse und Empfehlungen verständlich auf und präsentierst sie sicher gegenüber Entscheidungsträger:innen und internen Fachbereichen. Standards und Prozesse: Du entwickelst bestehende Arbeitsweisen, Qualitätsstandards und Prozesse weiter und sorgst dafür, dass erfolgreiche Ansätze nachhaltig im Team verankert werden. Was du mitbringst Fundierte SEA-Expertise: Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung im Suchmaschinenmarketing und kennst die Anforderungen an Planung, Steuerung und Optimierung komplexer performanceorientierter SEA-Maßnahmen. Operatives Plattformverständnis: Du kennst die operative Kampagnensteuerung aus eigener Erfahrung und kannst Accountstrukturen, Set-ups und Optimierungsentscheidungen in Google Ads und Microsoft Advertising fachlich sicher beurteilen. Strategisches Denken: Du ordnest Performance-Daten und operative Fragestellungen strategisch in einen größeren Zusammenhang ein, hinterfragst bestehende Maßnahmen und leitest daraus fundierte Empfehlungen und Weiterentwicklungen ab. Kritischer Blick: Du hinterfragst bestehende Maßnahmen und Prozesse konstruktiv, identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale und treibst deren Weiterentwicklung mit eigenen Impulsen voran. Steuerungs- und Beratungskompetenz: Du kannst fachliche Anforderungen klar formulieren, operative Teams zielgerichtet begleiten und unterschiedliche Stakeholder auf Augenhöhe zu einer gemeinsamen Lösung führen. Trackingverständnis: Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in Conversion-Tracking, Attribution, GA4 und idealerweise Google Tag Manager mit. Kommunikationsstärke: Du kannst komplexe Zusammenhänge verständlich vermitteln, Empfehlungen nachvollziehbar begründen und sicher vor unterschiedlichen Ansprechpartner:innen präsentieren. Eigenverantwortung und Organisation: Du arbeitest strukturiert, selbstständig und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch und behältst auch bei komplexen Themen, Prioritäten und Stakeholdern den Überblick. Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden dein Profil ab. Was uns besonders macht Wir bei emetriq sind ein Team von Experten, das mit Leidenschaft und Fachkenntnissen zusammenarbeitet, um das Unternehmen und uns selbst weiterzuentwickeln. Unsere Werte basieren auf Vertrauen, Agilität, Selbstorganisation und Eigenverantwortung – ohne starre Hierarchien, dafür mit klaren Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Mut zur Veränderung, Arbeiten auf Augenhöhe und teamübergreifende Zusammenarbeit prägen unsere Kultur. Wir suchen Menschen, die unsere Motivation und Begeisterung teilen. Unsere Benefits Hybrides Arbeiten : Dein Hauptstandort ist Bonn oder Hamburg: In Bonn bist du zweimal pro Woche vor Ort und gelegentlich in Hamburg. In Hamburg arbeitest du in der Regel einmal pro Woche im Büro und mindestens einmal im Monat in Bonn. An den übrigen Tagen entscheidest du selbst, ob du im Büro oder von zu Hause arbeitest. Flexible Arbeitszeiten : Keine Kernarbeitszeiten – 9 to 5 ist eine Möglichkeit, aber nicht die einzige Mobilität : Unterstützung durch JobRad und Deutschlandticket Mentale Gesundheit mit OpenUp : Anonyme, kostenlose Unterstützung durch Psycholog:innen Vergünstigungen : Personalkaufpreise für Telekomprodukte und eine Benefit-Card ohne Zuzahlung Teamspirit und Events : Workshops, Strategietage, Teamabende, Sportevents und gemeinsames Feierabendbier auf der Dachterrasse Verpflegung : Getränke, Siebträgermaschine, Snacks und Dachterrasse inklusive Klingt nach deiner nächsten Herausforderung? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung und darauf, gemeinsam die Zukunft des Programmatic Advertising zu gestalten! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Talent Acquisition Manager (m/w/d)
description: Talent Acquisition Manager (m/w/d) Du kennst den Unterschied zwischen einer geschalteten Anzeige und einer funktionierenden Recruiting-Strategie? Und du willst nicht nur eine Position im Haus besetzen, sondern die Personalgewinnung ganzer Unternehmen verantworten? Dann lies weiter. Im klassischen Inhouse-Recruiting arbeitest du an den Stellen, die dir zugewiesen werden, mit dem Budget, das jemand anderes verhandelt hat. Bei uns läuft es umgekehrt: Du entscheidest, welche Unternehmen du gewinnst, wie ihre Recruiting-Strategie aussieht und über welche Kanäle die Besetzung läuft. Beratung, Umsetzung und Ergebnis liegen in einer Hand – deiner. Aramaz Digital ist eine wachsende Recruiting-Beratung im Zentrum von Bielefeld. Wir machen Arbeitgeber sichtbar und liefern ihnen planbar passende Bewerbungen – über datengetriebene Kampagnen statt Zufallstreffer. Fachkräftemangel und demografische Entwicklung lassen diesen Markt jedes Jahr weiter wachsen. Deine Verantwortung Strategie und Beratung Du analysierst, warum die Personalgewinnung eines Unternehmens nicht liefert – Zielgruppe, Positionierung, Kanäle, Prozessgeschwindigkeit. Daraus entwickelst du eine belastbare Recruiting-Strategie und stellst sie den Entscheidern vor. Du gewinnst neue Kunden aktiv: über Telefon, Direktansprache und Empfehlungen. Kampagnen und Besetzung Du planst Recruiting-Kampagnen, steuerst sie über die Laufzeit und justierst anhand der Zahlen nach. Du prüfst eingehende Bewerbungen, führst Erstgespräche zur Vorauswahl und gestaltest eine Candidate Experience, die im Gedächtnis bleibt. Bis zur erfolgreichen Besetzung bleibt das Projekt in deiner Hand. Daten und Weiterentwicklung Du arbeitest sauber im CRM, kennst deine Kennzahlen und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab. description: Who is Boulevard? Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen . We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most . Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too. Come Do The Best Work Of Your Life At Boulevard As an Engineering Manager at Boulevard, you'll lead a team of talented engineers building the platform that powers thousands of self-care businesses. You'll balance technical leadership with people management, fostering a culture of excellence while delivering impactful products across a variety of domains. Our engineering teams are responsible for developing scalable, reliable, and user-centric solutions that help businesses grow and operate efficiently. Whether working on customer engagement, commerce, scheduling, or core platform capabilities, you’ll play a key role in shaping the future of our product and technology. What You'll Do Here: Lead and develop a team of 5-8 engineers across various experience levels. Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development planning. Partner with Product Management and Design to define and deliver the team roadmap. Drive technical excellence through code reviews and architectural guidance. Build a high-performing team culture focused on collaboration and growth. Manage team delivery, removing blockers, and ensuring successful execution. Contribute to hiring, interviewing, and onboarding new team members. Participate in on-call rotation and lead incident response when needed. Balance hands-on technical contribution with team enablement. What You'll Need To Thrive: 5+ years of software development experience with 2+ years of people management. Proven ability to lead and develop engineering teams. Strong technical background with the ability to provide architectural guidance. Experience with agile development and delivery management. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Track record of building inclusive, high-performing teams. Ability to navigate ambiguity and drive clarity for your team. Experience with remote team management and async collaboration. Nice To Have: Previous experience in B2B SaaS or marketing platforms. Background in payment systems, scheduling, or commerce platforms. For all other U.S. locations, the anticipated base salary range is $153,500 - $211,200 per year.
